speedups.no_full_container_speedup_claim: The container baseline timed 12,000 queries; the candidate timed all 210,414 remaining cells. These totals are not a matched speed ratio.

memory_policy.host_admission: Queue new workers when Linux MemAvailable <= min(2 GiB, 10% of host total). No interruption of running jobs.
memory_policy.limits: 15 GiB is an admission threshold, not a worker cap. The host check does not reserve future allocations or guarantee a running worker cannot exhaust host RAM.

reproduce.container_synthetic: docker exec -e PYTHONPATH=/app -e NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4 -e OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 <30GiB-4CPU-container> python -m altanalyze3.components.clustering.benchmarking.benchmark_projection_search --synthetic 240414 --baseline-query-cells 12000 --output <new-scratch-output>

scope_limits: UMAP-only tests. The original cloud visitor matrix was not obtained or rerun, and full workflow/one-million-cell/production-host safety is not claimed. Changes are uncommitted and no live service was restarted.
